method: RoboStats PowerStat: TrueSkill core (μ 25, σ 8.33, β 10, τ 1, draws 2%); quals 1×, elim win 2× / loss 0.25×, finals win 3× / loss 0.25×, Signature events ×1, score margin (typical 43 pts = 1×, cap 2×). Teams start from 50% of last season's rating. Match rating μ − 3σ + ln(1 + matches/20); rating = 90% match + 10% skills (by percentile within grade) + elim bonus ln(1 + elim points: champion 1, finalist 0.5, semifinalist 0.25, ×1.5 at Signature events).
